meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 当用户要求把某个技术内容讲成大白话时,Claude 会按 who(谁)、what(什么)、where(哪里)、why(为什么)、when(何时)五个方面给出通俗说明。
howto.when: 当用户说某东西“太技术/看不懂”、想要通俗解释,或直接问“它的 who/what/where/why/when 是什么”时触发。
howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to explain something technical in plain English, it gives a simple answer organized around who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you call something too technical and ask for a plain-English explanation, or directly ask for its who/what/where/why/when.

say_en.text: This is too technical. Explain it plainly as who/what/where/why/when.
Explain REST API using simple words and the who/what/where/why/when.
No jargon. Tell me about machine learning via who/what/where/why/when.
